source.quote: At acquisition select one actual possessed spellcasting route; use DC 8+current PB+that route’s current ability modifier. No phantom Wisdom/Spellcraft statistic. Actual source-specific component/target defenses still apply.

findings.problem: The current named-chain helper accepts Conjure Flora without its mandatory acquisition-time DC provider, rejects an explicit choice, and its initialization omits the provider. Trapcasting histories purchasing that parent inherit the incomplete parent record. The Verdant Bond-only parent path is unaffected.
findings.replacementWording: KEEP the already-operative SUP-07 floraBody/dc acquisition requirement: at acquisition permanently select and record one actual possessed spellcasting route as this feat's DC provider. Use DC 8 + current PB + that route's current casting-ability modifier; do not invent Wisdom, Spellcraft or another default. This source choice is separate from the later seedling mode/burst-type choice. Ownership initializes only the finite creation allowance and body capacity, with no plant, pending additional creation, command or active effect. All printed acquisition predicates and the actual earned feat opportunity remain required.
findings.evidence: Actual paid Warrior4 Magic Initiate(Wizard) then Warrior8 Conjure Flora reproduces missing-provider acceptance. Corrected in-memory helper rejects missing/foreign providers before payment and retains the chosen route with empty body state.
findings.closure: Apply guarded current text/model edits. In fresh descendant traces supply the real provider for every Conjure Flora parent; preserve old traces. Verify no body, no RP, no additional creation at acquisition and no refill on level10 capacity increase.

findings.problem: actual_casting_routes() rejects every supplied route whose actual source ability is STR or DEX. This narrows legitimately acquired personal routes. Soul Cage providers() delegates to the same helper. Existing INT/WIS/CHA-only witnesses do not establish the complete menu.
findings.replacementWording: Validate a route’s canonical ability against STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS and CHA only after its actually acquired source and qualifying repertoire have been established. Do not invent an ability or a CON route. The supplied current menus establish STR/DEX as well as INT/WIS/CHA. Voltyros INT fallback applies only when there is no actual casting source, not when an otherwise legitimate source has a nonmental ability.
findings.evidence: Source-qualified, separately paid Initiate(Dragoon), Initiate(Monk) and Initiate(Thief) witnesses reproduce the old rejection. Scoped corrected helper accepts them for Flora/Stormcaller and prevents false Voltyros INT fallback. This is not a cast or complete class build.
findings.closure: Apply one guarded helper edit and add source-route boundary coverage for all four affected procedures. Fixed explicit INT/WIS/CHA, INT/WIS or INT/CHA menus on other feats stay fixed; do not widen them.

findings.problem: Specific unarmed Mastery and composition of express Troll-unarmed wording with actual covering training were left outside the current weapon slice, not declared illegal. The forty inventory-profile list is not the universe of permitted Focus/Mastery choices.
findings.replacementWording: NEW FEAT335-ACQUISITION-AUDIT-01 profile-classification bridge, limited to Weapon Focus and Weapon Mastery: a specific unarmed-strike profile is an eligible choice when it is supplied by an actual current operative source and actual acquired proficiency covers it. The source-listed ordinary Unarmed strike remains a Simple melee training entry even though it is an attack option rather than an inventory object. An actual Simple-weapons proficiency grant covering that entry, or an express unarmed-strike proficiency grant, supplies the required training. An actually acquired Monk unarmed rule changes that same unarmed attack's operative statistics; its die progression alone is not a new paid profile or a free reselection. An acquired Troll Claws trait, explicitly used to make unarmed strikes, is an eligible specific Claws profile when the actor also has that actual unarmed-strike training. Bind both the real trait/body and its covering training grant; Claws alone grants no proficiency. No separate external training credential is necessary when those current-source grants already establish it. Another genuine natural profile remains source-qualified: require its actual profile and covering proficiency, whether an explicit unarmed bridge or another actual grant; neither an umbrella label nor this ruling supplies all-natural-weapon proficiency. No item, anatomy, attack or combined Monk/Claws damage formula is granted. Weapon Focus retains its express ongoing operative-proficiency requirement. Weapon Mastery checks proficiency at acquisition and retains its own matching-profile and total-level-six use predicates, without a new ongoing-proficiency gate. Its nonrepeatability, broadest applicable critical range, natural-19-meets-AC and natural-20-automatic-hit rules are unchanged.
findings.evidence: Included clauses establish ordinary Simple-melee Unarmed strike, actual Monk Simple training, the separate noninventory status, actual Troll Claws unarmed permission, Tavern Brawler’s express proficiency, and distinct Focus/Mastery checkpoints. No external RPG rule is used.
findings.closure: Append the exact narrow FS-02 bridge in both current shared envelopes and its manuscript. Add the finite proficient/unproficient ordinary/Monk/Claws acquisition boundaries below. No original profile/card status changes. Keep unprovided genuine natural profiles conditional rather than prohibited.

findings.problem: One ER-03 and558 ER-11 saved PASS comparisons have unequal serialized actual/expected values. Their helpers retain mutable references; later ordinary payment/selection changes the saved actual side after equality was tested. All209 numeric-slice identities have at least one such row. This is not proof that their predicate algorithms or rejected operations mutated incorrectly.
findings.replacementWording: Capture independent deep copies of actual and expected at the comparison checkpoint, compare those snapshots, and store those same snapshots. A later state transition must not change an earlier check record. Preserve the original reports; issue fresh, correctly version-bound descendant results or a source-linked corrective evidence addendum from actual re-execution of the affected checkpoints. Never edit a failed-looking historical actual into its expected value merely to make PASS appear consistent.
findings.evidence: All559 exact report pointers and saved values are inventoried. Isolated execution of each submitted capture function reproduces the reference-aliasing defect; an independent copied-snapshot reference stays stable after later mutation.
findings.closure: Apply the two guarded capture edits. Re-execute the bounded affected checkpoint histories with fresh output/source bindings, not the whole feat use engine. Check serialized PASS values remain equal after later legitimate commits and that positive final-state records remain separate.
